metrics_limitations: Before values are full host JSON, not exact former bounded model-prompt text.
Character counts are UTF-16-compatible for these fixture strings; not tokenizer measurements.

These deterministic tests establish compaction, retrieval and host-data preservation, not model speed or answer quality. Real prompt-token/latency evidence comes only from a separate inference protocol.
behavior: Authoritative selected schema replaces redundant all-capabilities list.
Common tree/house/rock details are aggregated with complete global logicalCounts and task scopeLogicalCounts.
Selection, unique exact named targets and task scope identities are retained; world/terrain/light/camera prioritized over large NPC collections.
Fast3000/Balanced4000/Deep6500 scene-character budgets; mandatory identity overflow is explicit rather than silent target loss.
Model task context retains original request, scope, constraints, ambiguity and indexed check results; full baseline IDs and stable criterion IDs stay in host task.
Evidence projection is bounded and reports truncation; newest eight task evidence entries are selected.
Readback <=3000 characters for validated tool payloads, complete counts/status plus limited asset samples and explicit omitted result count.
Full host task/results/live scene are unchanged; find_scene_objects and inspect_object retrieve omitted data.
Literal terrain parsing recognizes valley/village and world inflections; allowed qualifiers/nouns bind height to terrain, object/NPC height remains separate.
No completion shortcut: model review, independent checks and real editor jobs still control task outcome.
